content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denial for missing prior auth. Retro-auth window (30 days) is closed. Payer offers no peer-to-peer. The auth was truly missing at time of service, so a necessity appeal on this administrative denial is unlikely to succeed but is the only formal recourse; however, provider-caused auth failures typically can't be billed to the patient. Given no viable standard action to properly progress and the diligent specialist available, escalate for review of appeal options.","action":"escalate"}
